API ReferenceZscaler Private Access APIApp Connector Group ManagementUpdates the App Connector Group details for the specified ID.
Updates the App Connector Group details for the specified ID.
PUT
https://api.zsapi.net/zpa/mgmtconfig/v1/admin/customers/:customerId/appConnectorGroup/:appConnectorGroupId

Updates the App Connector Group details for the specified ID.

Request
​
PATH PARAMETERS
customerId
int64
REQUIRED

The unique identifier of the ZPA tenant.

appConnectorGroupId
int64
REQUIRED

The unique identifier of the App Connector Group.

QUERY PARAMETERS
microtenantId
int64

The unique identifier of the microtenant of ZPA tenant. For Default microtenant 0 should be passed and for Customer data microtenant should be null.
